title: Smoothness descends along arbitrary qcqs affine-transition limits
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(S_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Fix $i_0\in I$, quasi-compact quasi-separated $S_{i_0}$-schemes $X_{i_0},Y_{i_0}$, and an $S_{i_0}$-morphism $f_{i_0}:X_{i_0}\to Y_{i_0}$ locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Write $f_i$ and $f$ for its base changes to $S_i$ and $S$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], there is $i\geq i_0$ such that $f_j$ is smooth for every $j\geq i$. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on the stages.
